style: Avant-garde chamber-folk and music-hall vaudeville, harmony=quartal chord fields interrupted by barbershop voice leading and microtonal cluster rubs, melody=angular hocketed fragments opening into sudden sustained operatic vowels with downward yodel register flips, rhythm=asymmetric Balkan 7/8 pulse invaded by swinging triplet subdivisions and abrupt metric stops, timbre=accordion, bowed saw, upright bass, brushed snare, barrelhouse piano, and close-miked vocal group, performance=theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision, production=dry 1960s mono room capture with sudden spatial throws and dynamic dropouts
lyrics:
[Scene Introduction: The Non-Euclidean Taproom]
[Tempo: Frantic, 172 BPM]
[Time Signature: 7/8 shifting to swinging 4/4]

[Verse 1]
[Dry spoken narration with deadpan administrative precision]
Three dimensions poured a pint of bitter logic into a four-sided vessel.
The container leaked through the ceiling and pooled upon the linoleum floor.
We measured the radius of the spilled beverage using a rusted compass.
It pointed directly toward Tuesday afternoon and the back of a chair.

[Chorus]
[Tight close-harmony doo-wop with non-diatonic cluster rubs]
Oh, the tesseract is drinking again!
Pouring polynomials down its throat!
Watch the corners blur and soften!
Watch the volume lose its vote!
[Yodel register flip up into soprano range]
[Abrupt metric stop]

[Verse 2]
[Rapid patter singing, close-miked and percussive]
Calculate the volume of the goblet when the walls are made of glass and smoke.
Every time it takes a swip, a parallel postulate goes up in flame and choke.
We checked the ledger twice and found three extra angles hiding underneath the floor.
They do not belong to Euclid, and they refuse to exit through the proper door.

[Bridge]
[Balkan brass and bowed saw drone supporting whispered ensemble rhythm]
[Whispered ensemble rhythm]
Surface tension snaps.
Algebra collapses into foam.
The drink forgets its cup.
The geometry comes home staggering.
[Spoken command]
Stir the coordinates!

[Chorus]
[Full ensemble, theatrical vaudeville belt with barbershop harmony]
Oh, the tesseract is drinking again!
Pouring polynomials down its throat!
Watch the corners blur and soften!
Watch the volume lose its vote!
[Barrelhouse piano solo with manic triplet runs]

[Verse 3]
[Operatic recitative with comic overstatement]
Behold the consequence of excessive spatial alcohol consumption!
Hyper-dimensional vertigo spreads across the municipal district!
Lines that were parallel now embrace like intoxicated sailors in an alley!
The hypotenuse has fallen asleep behind the upright piano!

[Break]
[A Cappella hocketing fragments passed between voices with hard consonant attacks]
Tick, tok, tesser-oc, drink, clink, link, sink.
Tick, tok, tesser-oc, drink, clink, link, sink.
[Brushed snare roll accelerating into metric compression]

[Verse 4]
[Call-and-response between solo baritone and massed vocal group]
(Solo) Who is paying the tab for this multidimensional bender?
(Group) The fourth axis is listed as the primary financial offender!
(Solo) Where did the angles go when the bartender cut them off?
(Group) They dissolved into syllables and tumbled through the roof!

[Outro]
[Decelerating waltz pulse invaded by swinging triplets]
Fold the pages back into a book that never was written.
Melt the glass polygon until the liquid mathematics are smitten.
The tesseract has gone to sleep beneath the cellar stairs.
Leave it there.
Just leave it there.
[Single plucked bass note ringing out into absolute silence]
[End]
caption: An avant-garde chamber-folk vaudeville track where a geometric tesseract goes on an intoxicated bender. Combining asymmetric 7/8 rhythms, barbershop vocal clusters, bowed saw, and deadpan administrative narration, the arrangement collapses spatial dimensions into absurd musical theater.
